title: Hadrian hero
description: A window-tall navy hero that stays pinned while the page slides over it: a big tight two-line grotesk heading with a short line beside it, then a wide media frame with a sky-blue hairline, rounded top and machined 45° chamfers at its foot, holding two square outline buttons. Words fade in one by one on load; as you scroll they fade out and sink.
notes: pinned with position: sticky for the length of its parent; the blocks after it must be opaque (the Hadrian blocks are) so they cover it
the scroll fade-out reads the page's scroll (scroll(root)), so it expects to be the first section
the frame is a clip-path; media placed in it is cropped to the chamfered shape (cover)
CSS only; with reduced motion everything shows at once and stays put
name: hadrian-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the heading, one string per line (two short lines read best)

props.name: text
props.description: one short line beside the heading on desktop, under it on phones

props.name: actions
props.description: up to two buttons sitting in the foot of the frame

props.name: media
props.description: the frame's media (a video or image filling it, object-cover); a placeholder when empty

props.name: pinned
props.description: stay pinned behind the following sections (sticky); off = scrolls away normally
